jobs.description:
We are looking for a software developer to join our Home & Pro product development team at Dirac at our office in Copenhagen, Danmark. If you are eager to work with cutting-edge audio technologies and contribute to innovative audio solutions, this role is for you. You will work on the Dirac Live end-user application that helps bring our latest flagship technologies to market, including Dirac Live Active Room Treatment (ART), now available on several leading OEMs.
What Dirac Offers You
At Dirac, we provide a highly entrepreneurial environment where you can be part of a team that is passionate about building a great business and inventing the future of sound. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work in leading-edge technologies that make a real impact on everyday experiences. You’ll be a part of a supportive and collaborative agile development team that values quality and continuous improvement. You’ll join a product area with strong momentum, with Dirac Live expanding across premium home audio categories, from AV receivers and processors to streaming amplifiers and soundbars.
Key responsibilities
As a software developer for Dirac Live, you will join an agile product team of passionate developers and audio enthusiasts. You will contribute to the solution’s end-user application, including design, implementation, testing, and evaluation of the front-end. You will be key in integration, testing, and release. Most of the implementation is in C++ and the application is released for Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. The team also releases plug-ins for digital audio workstations. This code is written in JUCE and is also part of your responsibilities.
Develop the Dirac Live application for desktop and mobile
Implement new features, as well as testing and maintenance of the existing applications
Implement the user interfaces using Qt QML and JUCE
Configure and evaluate the complete solution using audio equipment in our audio labs
Assist the product manager to refine complex and large work items into smaller, valuable and estimated user stories
Assist with 2nd-line customer support

Who you are
Master of Science in Computer Science, Engineering Physics or a related field
2+ years of industry experience of UI development
Experience building cross-platform applications for desktop and mobile
Programming experience and proficiency in C++
A team-oriented attitude, as well as the ability to work independently
Fluency in both spoken and written English
Valid work permit or citizenship that allows you to work in Denmark

Desired qualifications
Programming experience with Qt QML or similar languages
Strong passion for audio, and experience setting up audio systems for recording and mixing audio
Experience with relevant software engineering tools for CI/CD (Git, CMake, Conan)
Experience with agile development
Experience collaborating on UI/UX and product design
Familiarity with signal processing

About Dirac
Dirac is an audio tech company, known for best-in-class technology and a prestigious customer base that includes many of the world’s most reputable brands. We are passionate about audio and innovation, and our pioneering technology is shaping the future of sound experiences.
We are a global company with headquarters in Uppsala, Sweden, and R&D facilities in Copenhagen, Denmark, and Bangalore, India, with representation in Greater China, Germany, Japan, Korea, and the United States.
Please read more about us at https://www.dirac.com/ and follow us on social media!
Location
The location will be at Dirac’s R&D office in Copenhagen.

jobs.occupation: Senior C++ Software Engineer  Sensor Control & Radar Systems
jobs.description:
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Software Engineer for a challenging consulting assignment with an internationally renowned client in the advanced technology and defense industry in Gothenburg, Sweden.
Are you passionate about modern C++ development, Linux-based software systems, and advanced sensor technologies? This is an exciting opportunity to develop core software for sophisticated radar platforms, contributing to products across the entire software lifecycle—from concept and design to deployment, maintenance, and continuous improvement.
We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, takes ownership of deliverables, and thrives in a collaborative environment with a high degree of responsibility and autonomy.
📍 Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
🎯 Seniority: Senior / Professional Level 4
💻 Core technologies: C++, Linux, Agile, CI/CD
🔐 Security: Successful security clearance required
🎯 About the Role
As a Senior Software Engineer within the Sensor Control Software team, you will develop and maintain core software components for advanced radar and sensor systems.
You will contribute throughout the software development lifecycle, working on current and future sensor platforms. Your responsibilities will include software design, implementation, testing, integration, and maintenance, with a focus on delivering reliable, high-quality software for technically complex applications.
🔧 Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain core software components using modern C++.
Contribute to software development for advanced radar and sensor platforms.
Work across the full product lifecycle, from concept and development to deployment and maintenance.
Develop and troubleshoot software in Linux-based development environments.
Implement and maintain automated tests to ensure software quality and reliability.
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions.
Work with version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automated development workflows.
Apply agile software development practices to deliver incremental improvements.
Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to solve complex technical problems.
Take ownership of assigned components and drive issues through to resolution.

✅ Required Skills & Qualifications
Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or equivalent relevant experience.
At least 5 years of professional software development experience.
Strong hands-on programming skills in C++.
Experience working in Linux-based development environments.
Solid understanding of software engineering principles and modern development practices.
Experience with version control systems, automated testing, and CI/CD.
Good knowledge of agile software development methodologies.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently, take technical ownership, and collaborate effectively within a team.
Fluent in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.

⭐ Additional Strengths
Experience developing software for radar, sensors, signal processing, or other complex embedded systems.
Familiarity with real-time or performance-critical software.
Experience with continuous integration, automated verification, and software quality assurance.
Strong understanding of collaborative development workflows and engineering best practices.

👤 Our Ideal Candidate
You are a technically strong software engineer who enjoys understanding complex systems and solving challenging engineering problems.
You write clean, maintainable code, take responsibility for the quality of your work, and collaborate effectively with other specialists. You are comfortable working autonomously while contributing to shared engineering goals and continuous improvement.
🔐 Important: Security Clearance
This assignment involves working with classified information. Successful completion of the required security clearance process is mandatory before taking up the assignment. Eligibility will be assessed according to the applicable security requirements.
📩 Interested in This Opportunity?
If you have strong C++ development experience, Linux expertise, and a passion for advanced sensor software, we’d like to hear from you.
Please submit your updated CV highlighting your C++ experience, Linux development, automated testing, and CI/CD expertise. Include your availability and earliest possible start date.
👉 Explore the opportunity and apply:
https://www.hykmann.com/careers

TL;DR:
Lovable's mobile app (React Native, iOS/Android, owned by Team Everywhere) mirrors the web app's functionality while adding native login, push notifications, in-app top-ups, and haptics - it's one of the fastest-growing ways builders reach Lovable. The role is a product-minded fullstack engineer to own end-to-end mobile slices: native flows, auth, push, the web-native bridge, and app store ops (TestFlight, Play Console, compliance) across the full stack.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we’re looking for
At least 6 years of relevant experience at high-pace, high-scale companies
Strong fullstack background: deep comfort with TypeScript/React on the frontend and Node.js or similar on the backend
Hands-on experience with React Native in production, including native module integration.
Experience shipping and maintaining apps through the App Store and Google Play, including review/compliance cycles (Sign in with Apple, IAP, Android policy review)
Product instinct: you think in user outcomes, not just API endpoints
Comfort working with third-party services and building clean abstractions over vendor APIs. Familiarity with managed cloud services (AWS, GCP) and the tradeoffs of buy-vs-build
Experience with push notification infrastructure or native device integrations is a strong plus
You've shipped features in fast-moving, high-ownership environments where you wore multiple hats

What you’ll do
Build and own native mobile features end-to-end: onboarding, auth, push notifications, in-app purchases/credit top-ups, and share targets
Improve the web-native bridge that connects the in-app WebView experience to native device capabilities (keyboard handling, haptics, camera, file sharing)
Own App Store and Play Store submissions, review compliance, and release tooling (TestFlight, Play Console, Fastlane)
Diagnose and fix native-specific bugs and performance issues (cold start, preview loading, crash handling) across iOS and Android

Our Tech Stack
We're building with tools that both humans and AI love. Lovable software engineers are capable of working across the whole stack. Examples of tech in our stack include:
Mobile: React Native, TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin
Frontend: React and Typescript
Backend: Golang and Rust
Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Firebase
Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery
DevOps & Tooling: CI/CD pipelines, OTEL, Kubernetes, Terraform, Fastlane

And always on the lookout for what's next!
About your application
Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

We believe great companies are built by people who are driven to solve difficult problems.
At Nextory, we're building the future of reading and listening. It's an ambitious goal that demands exceptional execution, relentless curiosity, and a willingness to challenge convention. We set a high bar for ourselves because we believe that's what it takes to create products people love.
If you're motivated by impact, energized by ambitious teammates, and excited by the opportunity to build something category-defining, you'll feel at home here.
Let us tell you about the role 📖
This is an Account Manager role that combines opening new doors with creating relationships that last. You’ll be part of our Commercial Business Development team, where you’ll find and sign new valuable partners, while also developing the collaborations we already have across the Nordics. All with one main goal: bringing new listeners and readers to Nextory.
Your main responsibilities will include:

Identifying high-value prospects, reaching out and booking meetings

Negotiating and signing new partner agreements

Planning and launching the first campaign together with new partners

Continuously booking marketing activities with existing partners to drive conversions

Following up on results and finding new ways to improve each collaboration

Working closely with colleagues in Marketing, Product and Analytics to bring campaigns to life

Your story so far 👀
We believe you’re a relationship builder with a hunter’s instinct. You get energy from meeting new people and turning a good conversation into a signed deal, and you’re just as motivated by what comes after: making the collaboration & results grow. Most of all, you’re curious. You like trying new things, taking initiative, and experimenting, even when not everything works out, because around here, that’s how we learn.
Furthermore, we believe you have:

A degree in business administration, marketing, economics or similar

2-4 years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or B2B sales

A proven track record of finding new business and closing deals

Experience running campaigns & creating marketing materials together with partners or other external stakeholders

Fluency in Swedish and English, written and spoken

We’d be especially happy to see:

That you speak French

Experience from digital subscription services, streaming, media or consumer tech

A network in the Nordic market, for example within telecom, banking and loyalty programs, employee benefits or travel

That you’re comfortable working with data and analysis

You don’t need to tick every box. If you love closing deals and have great instincts when it comes to growing partnerships, we want to talk to you.
The Nextory way of working 🏠
At Nextory, we believe a strong and inclusive culture is key to our success and that culture flourishes when we meet and collaborate in person as much as possible. That’s why we spend the majority of the working time at our beautiful office!
We are based in Stockholm, Sweden, with offices in Paris and Bangalore. Our hybrid work policy includes four days in the office and Wednesdays as a work-from-home day.
Your next story starts here 💫
We look forward to your application! Applications are reviewed continuously.
Please note that we do not offer relocation and that a six-month probationary period applies.

jobs.occupation: Technical Writer to a global company in Ludvika
jobs.description:
About our client
Our client, who is a global and world leading actor within their domain, strongly believe in the long-term sustainability of HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) technology. This technology facilitates energy transfer with direct current at high voltages, making it suitable for transmitting energy over long distances and connecting electricity networks with minimal losses. In addition to energy transfer, HVDC technology addresses electricity quality issues and contributes to the stabilization of connected power grids. For offshore wind power or long-distance underwater transmissions, direct current is the most realistic energy transmission alternative.
About the role
On behalf of our client, we are looking for an experienced Technical Writer to join their team in Ludvika.
In this role, you will be responsible for creating, structuring, and maintaining technical documentation for complex electrical systems and installations, covering everything from high- and low-voltage systems to control systems, HMI, and related equipment.
You will work closely with system engineers, technical specialists, and project teams to gather, analyze, and transform complex technical information into clear, accurate, and well-structured documentation. The role requires both technical understanding and strong communication skills, as you will play an important part in ensuring that technical information is accessible, consistent, and easy to understand across different engineering projects.
Key responsibilities
Create, structure, and maintain technical documentation for electrical installations, systems, and engineering solutions

Gather and interpret technical information in close collaboration with engineers and technical specialists

Produce user manuals, system descriptions, technical specifications, and other relevant documentation

Review, improve, and standardize existing technical documentation to ensure quality, accuracy, and consistency

Plan and coordinate documentation activities across multiple engineering projects

Contribute to improving documentation processes, templates, and ways of working

Who are you?
We are looking for a structured and communicative person who enjoys combining technical understanding with clear and precise writing. You have a genuine interest in technology and the ability to understand complex technical systems and explain them in a way that is easy for others to understand.
To succeed in this role, you are analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, manage your own priorities, and enjoy collaborating with engineers and technical specialists across different projects. You also take pride in delivering high-quality documentation and contributing to the development of effective ways of working.
We are looking for someone who has:
At least 5 years of experience in technical writing or technical documentation

A university degree, Bachelor’s or higher, in a relevant technical field

Experience documenting complex technical systems or engineering solutions

Good written and verbal communication skills in English

It is considered an advantage if you also have:
Experience with electrical systems, power systems, HVDC technology, or industrial installations

Good communication skills in Swedish

Practical information
Location: Ludvika, Sweden
Scope: Full-time
Start date: As agreed
Employment type: In this recruitment process, you will initially be employed as a consultant by A-hub and work on assignment at our client. After 12 months, the ambition is for you to transition into direct employment with the client.

We look forward to receiving your application!
A-hub is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse working environment. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

By submitting your application for this job, you are consenting to A-hub using your personal information in accordance with our GDPR compliance policy.

The Opportunity
At Hitachi Energy Components in Ludvika, we are continuing to grow and develop our business. As more employees join our organization and new competencies are required, ensuring a structured and effective approach to onboarding, training, and competency development has become increasingly important.
We are now looking for a Training & Development Specialist who will take ownership of our internal training structure and learning processes. This is a newly established role with significant opportunity to influence how onboarding, training, and competency development are managed across our organization.
We are looking for someone who enjoys creating structure, coordinating initiatives, and working with a broad range of stakeholders. You bring experience from an industrial, manufacturing, energy, or other technical environment and are comfortable collaborating with technical experts and operational teams.

How you’ll make an impact
Coordinate onboarding and support the continuous improvement of the new employee experience.
Develop and maintain internal training processes and competency development structures.
Coordinate training programs and collaborate with stakeholders across Sweden and globally to ensure relevant and up-to-date training content.
Create and maintain training materials, presentations, guides, and learning resources.
Support subject matter experts in developing structured and effective training programs.
Manage learning systems, training documentation, records, and competency data.
Track training KPIs, identify improvement opportunities, and support continuous development of learning initiatives.

Your Background
Experience in a coordination-focused role such as project coordination, HR, administration, executive support, competency management, or similar.
Experience from an industrial, manufacturing, energy, or engineering environment, with the ability to understand technical roles, processes, and competency requirements.
Experience supporting, delivering, or coordinating training and development initiatives is highly regarded.
Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the confidence to engage and present across different functions and organizational levels.
A continuous improvement mindset with the ability to identify development opportunities and drive improvements.
Professional communication skills in both Swedish and English.

 We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​

Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​

About Plus1 
Plus1 is a fast-growing fintech on a mission to give people total control over their personal finances. We don’t just offer loans, we build digital solutions and provide expert advisory services that make a real difference across Europe. Plus1 is part of 0TO9 AB, a licensed credit market company supervised by the Swedish FSA (Finansinspektionen).
We are scaling quickly and building out our organization. This is your chance to join a team where your voice carries weight, where you help set the direction, and where you can help build the next fintech success story.
Learn more about Plus1
The Role
We are looking for a Product Manager who doesn’t just set direction, but builds. You will join our product and tech team of 11 in Stockholm, report directly to the CEO and work closely with the management team.
We don’t split the product into silos with individual owners. We work full stack, all hands on deck, across the entire customer and business chain. Priorities are set together with management, with special focus on:

Traffic generation

Onboarding and conversion

Retention and dunning

The credit granting process

Market expansion

Internal systems used by our advisors and customer service agents

We build a lot ourselves with Claude Code. As a PM you won’t just write requirements and manage the backlog. You will pair with our developers, build prototypes, internal tools and analyses yourself, and improve how we work every day.
Your mission includes:

Driving priorities and roadmap across our focus areas, based on data, customer insight and business impact.

Building and shipping hands-on together with the developers, from prototype to production.

Monitoring performance across the funnel, from first click to repayment, and acting quickly when something needs adjusting.

Making sure everything we build meets regulatory requirements, including consumer credit regulation, CCD2, AML/KYC and GDPR, in close collaboration with legal, compliance and credit.

Managing external partners such as payment providers, brokers and credit bureaus.

Aligning internal stakeholders across credit, customer service, finance, marketing and management.

Contributing to launches in new markets, from requirements and partner setup to go-live.

As a member of our team, you will represent the company to our customers while carrying out the work. Most of the work takes place in different areas of Sweden, and you will be working outdoors, on the tiled roofs of residential properties.
Your duties will include cleaning tiled roofs and facades. This is a varied job involving many different activities and procedures. Overnight travel may also be required.
At the beginning of your employment, you will receive relevant training in the use of high-pressure cleaning equipment and in working at heights. Previous experience in these areas is, of course, an additional advantage.
The work takes place in different areas of Sweden, from the west coast to the east coast. This means that, alongside your work, you will have the opportunity to experience different parts of the country and discover Sweden from a different perspective.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
This is a physically demanding job that requires good physical ability and skill in using your body, hands, and various tools.
You will work in a two-person team responsible for roof cleaning. For this reason, we place great importance on your ability to cooperate and communicate effectively, accept and handle feedback, and, above all, be willing to work hard and pull your weight when needed.
If you have a colleague or friend who is also interested in coming to work in Sweden, we would be happy to know. The possibility of starting together can make it much easier to form a team, as two people usually work together in each team. In this way, if you come together, the team can be ready from the beginning.
Roof cleaning can involve unexpected challenges related to the surface, dimensions, and similar issues. We are therefore looking for someone who is solution-oriented, is not afraid to take initiative, and can suggest creative solutions.

• Good knowledge of English.
• B or BE driving licence.
ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
• Good knowledge of Greek.
• Experience using high-pressure washing equipment, carpentry, roof installation/construction, or similar work involving machinery.
• Experience in the construction and assembly of scaffolding.
• Experience in cleaning and painting tiled roofs, as well as cleaning and painting facades.

• Good opportunities for professional development.
• Variety in your daily work, with different types of tasks for our customers.
• Work in different areas of Sweden.

• Statutory insurance coverage.
• Good benefits and working conditions.
• Hourly-paid employment.

Working in different areas of Sweden is not only a professional opportunity, but also a way to experience the country, visit different places, and gain new experiences.

jobs.occupation: Orthopaedic Specialists Wanted for Coastal Hospital in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Dignus Medical collaborates with several established healthcare providers across Sweden. We are currently receiving ongoing requests from hospitals in central Sweden seeking specialist physicians in orthopaedics. These opportunities arise regularly as healthcare providers expand their orthopaedic services and strengthen their specialist teams.
We are continuously interested in connecting with Orthopaedic Surgeons who are open to exploring professional opportunities in Sweden.
The Role
As a specialist in orthopaedics, you will work in a modern hospital environment alongside multidisciplinary teams focused on high-quality patient care. The clinical work typically includes both elective orthopaedic surgery and acute trauma care, depending on the structure of the department.
Common responsibilities include:
Assessment and treatment of musculoskeletal disorders and injuries
Elective orthopaedic procedures depending on experience and subspecialty
Participation in trauma and emergency orthopaedic care
Outpatient consultations and follow-up care
Collaboration with physiotherapists, radiologists, and other medical specialists
Participation in clinical development and quality improvement work

Hospitals in this region often manage a broad orthopaedic case mix, offering opportunities to work with both common orthopaedic conditions and more complex cases.
Location and Lifestyle
The opportunities are located in a region of central Sweden known for its coastal landscapes, forests, rivers, and open countryside. The area offers excellent access to nature and outdoor activities year-round, including hiking, fishing, skiing, and boating.
Daily life is practical and well-organized. Cities in this region offer short commuting distances, accessible housing, and well-developed public services. Schools, childcare, and healthcare services are easily available, making the region suitable both for individuals relocating alone and for physicians moving with their families.
The lifestyle combines a calm environment with reliable infrastructure and convenient travel connections to larger Swedish cities.
Qualifications
EU-recognized specialist certification in Orthopaedics
Solid clinical experience in orthopaedic practice
Experience in trauma care and elective orthopaedic procedures is beneficial
Ability to work independently while collaborating in multidisciplinary teams
Good communication skills in English
Willingness to learn Swedish

What Dignus Medical Offers You
Ongoing support from a dedicated recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required
Help with accommodation and travel arrangements, including support for your family, if necessary
Access to a free language course with a private tutor

Why Choose Dignus Medical?
We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.
Interested in learning more?
Contact us to learn more about current and upcoming opportunities for orthopaedic specialists in Sweden, or submit your application today. Dignus Medical looks forward to helping you explore the next step in your career.
We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

A leading university hospital in southwestern Sweden is now recruiting specialists in pediatric ophthalmology to strengthen its highly specialized eye care department. This is an exciting opportunity to work with advanced diagnostics and nationally designated care for pediatric glaucoma and cataract, while contributing to education, clinical development, and research within one of Sweden’s foremost ophthalmology units.
About the role
You will join a large ophthalmology department with more than 250 professionals, covering outpatient care, emergency eye services, inpatient wards, and surgical units. The pediatric ophthalmology section provides comprehensive diagnostic and therapeutic care for children and collaborates closely with electrophysiology and hereditary disease units.
You will work in multidisciplinary teams that include physicians, orthoptists, nurses, optometrists, and technicians, all focused on delivering patient-centered, high-quality eye care. Requirements
EU-recognized specialist certification in ophthalmology
Minimum five years of clinical experience in ophthalmology
Focus and competence in pediatric ophthalmology
Strong interest in teaching, research, and clinical development
Good communication skills in English and willingness to learn Swedish
Team-oriented, responsible, and committed to providing high-quality patient care
Experience or competence in medical retina is considered an advantage

A willingness and motivation to learn Swedish is important for your integration and clinical work.
The relocation process begins once you reach language level B2. During this stage, you will work 50% clinically and study 50% Swedish until you achieve C1 level, which is required to apply for a Swedish specialist license (specialistbevis) to practice as a specialist doctor.
Language training is provided free of charge once you have accepted an employment offer.
You will receive full support throughout the licensing and relocation process, including assistance with documentation, Swedish authorization, and settling in Sweden.
